name: Gold Ride-the-Run
plain_words: Hold gold at half its normal size; add a quarter each time gold prints a new 20-day high, up to the normal size (the vol-target cap); a 20-day low ends the run and resets to half. Compared with simply holding gold at full size.
related: Adds were tested once as 'leverage in a costume' (2026-09-09, off switch). This is the declared re-test WITH the cap.
expectation: More return per unit held, but the cap means less held on average; return/drawdown probably does not improve. The uncapped variant (adds above the vol target) is expected to add return and a deeper hole — leverage. Honest odds: 1 in 5.
